regime_context: US thematic leadership is concentrated in AI/semiconductor-related names, but this is an attention/focus read, not a return forecast; the detector's only validated edge here is drawdown/shake-out control via the absolute-trend gate (gate_helps=true). Momentum rank-IC is ~0 and rotation-timing has no forward edge, so any directional lean is my fallible judgment expressed as a conditional.
emerging_watch: Watch for a confirmed leadership handoff from AI Infrastructure to Semiconductor Equipment (WFE): the challenger's score is 1.698 vs leader 2.253 with margin 0.555, but WFE is crowded and the detector's rotation-timing has no validated edge. I would retire this watch only if WFE's score overtakes AI Infrastructure AND its non-crowded breadth stays above 0.8 for a full week — otherwise it is just noise.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure sits atop the momentum rank with the highest score and a strong durability bar (0.73), wide breadth (0.875), and is not crowded (crowding_z 0.81, crowded=false). Because the trend gate is the one validated leg in this market, and eligibility is true, the lean is to stay with leadership through the absolute-trend lens — not because the rank predicts returns, but because the gate historically trims drawdown while in-trend names remain eligible.
theses.dissent: The AI Infrastructure theme is heavily correlated with the broader semis/AI complex and could mean-revert sharply on a single earnings or macro surprise; momentum rank carries no forward return edge, so an overweight is purely a staying-power bet that the trend gate will exit before a deep drawdown.

falsifier.text: SMH closes below its 30-trading-day lower absolute-trend threshold before the check-by date (within 30 trading days).

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity has full breadth (1.0), a very high durability bar (0.81), a trend hurst tag, and is eligible. It is crowded (crowding_z 1.91), which under the guardrails is a size-down caution, not a fade. The lean is to hold direction through the trend gate while acknowledging crowding argues for smaller exposure.
theses.dissent: Crowding at the 99th+ percentile is a topping texture; being the most crowded eligible theme raises the odds of a sharp air-pocket if the trend breaks, and the momentum rank itself has no return edge.

falsifier.text: CIBR lags the S&P 500 by more than 5% cumulative before the check-by date while still flagged eligible.

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners is ineligible (eligible=false) with a very low durability bar (0.13), extremely weak breadth (0.125), and a mean-revert hurst tag. The absolute-trend gate is the one validated risk-control leg, and this theme has already been gated out; staying away aligns with the discipline of not fighting the gate.
theses.dissent: Mean-reverting themes can snap back hard on a squeeze, and avoided names sometimes outperform in a rotation; the detector has no forward timing edge, so an avoid is only a discipline call, not a return forecast.

falsifier.text: SIL closes above its absolute-trend eligibility threshold (durability bar recovers toward 0.5+) for 10 consecutive trading days before the check-by date.
